description: GM Public Transport Schedules – GTFS and TXC datasets is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport for Greater Manchester. Data updated nightly. Public transport schedule data for all bus and Metrolink tram services within the Greater Manchester boundary. Regularly updated by TfGM. For details of what the data in the fields represents, you may find it useful to look at the General Transit Feed Specification Reference page - a link to this is below. Coverage: Transport for Greater Manchester. The portal files it under the publisher Transport for Greater Manchester. It offers 4 resource(s) in CSV/ZIP, HTML, PDF, XML/ZIP. The portal shows 2025-02-05 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
